Three Stages.
Zero Guesswork.

Every frame moves through the same deterministic pipeline, in the same order, every time. Nothing here is a trained model. You can trace exactly what each stage does to every pixel.

01 · CONTRAST

Histogram Stretch

Hazy scenes compress into a narrow gray band. We read the real per-channel histogram and stretch it back across the full 0–255 range, clipping outlier pixels so a few blown highlights don't compress the scale.

02 · FREQUENCY

Frequency-Domain Filter

The luminance channel goes through a 2D FFT. A high-boost filter leaves low frequencies, including the haze, alone, and amplifies the high frequencies that carry edges, texture, and structure.

03 · ADAPTIVE

Adaptive Smoothing + Sharpening

A Sobel gradient map finds real edges. Flat, noisy regions get smoothed; edges get sharpened, so rooflines and lane markings stay crisp without amplifying sensor grain.
